subject.title: Remote skill bin probe times out when node is co-located with gateway (macOS app as node on same host)

question: For macOS app-backed nodes, should remote skill-bin refresh preserve approved system.which/system.run and become readiness-aware, or should OpenClaw skip probes for app/co-located nodes?
rationale: The choice changes remote exec compatibility, startup noise, stale-bin behavior, and skill availability freshness; current source proves the remaining decision surface but does not settle the product contract.

options.title: Defer And Back Off Probes
options.body: Preserve the macOS app command surface, delay the initial probe until the node is ready, add bounded retry/backoff, and require live co-located plus remote macOS proof.

options.title: Skip Co-Located App Probes Only
options.body: Suppress the same-host warning path while leaving remote macOS app probe timing and retries to a separate follow-up.

options.title: Replace The Stale Probe PR
options.body: Ask for or sponsor a fresh narrow PR on src/skills/runtime/remote.ts that credits the cache/backoff work without adopting its stale branch directly.

recommendation.title: Defer And Back Off Probes
recommendation.body: Preserve the macOS app command surface, delay the initial probe until the node is ready, add bounded retry/backoff, and require live co-located plus remote macOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal around remote skills, mac node exec, and the security/product boundary this decision affects.
